cards.power: +1 Dice if the crowd is cheering. If you cheat, you lose the game immediately.
cards.lore: Use exciting, high-flying moves because audiences cheer for that. A slave to approval.
cards.gradeReason: Iconic archetype — crowd-pleaser rule locked in, zero explanation needed.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Retro comic. Subject: Heroic golden retriever wrestler soaring off ropes. Mood: Pure crowd-pop euphoria.

cards.power: Cancel an opponent's successful attack by cheating. Gain 1 Heat token.
cards.lore: Brutal, sneaky moves. Bear hugs and eye pokes. If they aren't booing, you aren't doing your job.
cards.gradeReason: Perfect villain brief — 'If they aren't booing, you aren't doing your job.' Embody immediately.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Pulp cartoon. Subject: Sneering weasel wrestler eye-poking bear opponent. Mood: Delicious villainy.

cards.power: Flip a coin at start of turn to decide if you are Face or Heel.
cards.lore: The audience decides to cheer for you on their own. You don't ask for it, which makes them want you more.
cards.gradeReason: Coin flip mechanic IS the character — chaotic neutrality made playable.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Split-panel comic. Subject: Cool cat wrestler half-hero half-villain, crowd split. Mood: Magnetic ambiguity.

cards.power: When defeated, you may choose who defeats you. That is your only control.
cards.lore: Isolated and picked apart. You exist to make the other guy look [good].
cards.gradeReason: 'That is your only control' — poignant but 'jobber' needs a beat of insider context.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Sad-funny comic. Subject: Goat wrestler being beaten while nobly choosing attacker. Mood: Dignified sacrifice.

cards.power: Immune to all 'Throw' attacks. Cannot use 'Aerial' moves.
cards.lore: 400-pound gorilla. Slow, but strong enough to hurl you like a ragdoll. Visual shorthand for 'You Can't Win'.
cards.gradeReason: 400-pound gorilla visual shorthand — every player knows this archetype instantly.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Old-school cartoon. Subject: Massive gorilla wrestler unmoved as opponent bounces off. Mood: Immovable wall energy.

cards.power: Dodge any attack on a roll of 5+. If you fail, take double damage.
cards.lore: Agile and fast. Focus on strikes. If you stand still, you die.
cards.gradeReason: 'If you stand still, you die' — instant performance directive. High-risk style locked in.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Dynamic manga-comic. Subject: Flying squirrel wrestler mid-corkscrew. Mood: Airborne reckless speed.

cards.power: Roll d6. On 1, you crush yourself. On 6, you crush everyone.
cards.lore: Risk of injury is high. A 400-pounder leaping off the top rope is a tragedy waiting to happen.
cards.gradeReason: Chaos mechanic is clear but 'botch' is wrestling-specific vocabulary.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Slapstick comic. Subject: Enormous rhino airborne off turnbuckle, ring buckling. Mood: Glorious catastrophe incoming.

cards.power: Can lift characters size 'Large' or 'Huge'. Surprise factor doubles damage.
cards.lore: Smaller wrestlers showing surprising strength. Defying the ph[ysics of size].
cards.gradeReason: Classic underdog trope but mechanics need a read-through to activate fully.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Cartoon action. Subject: Tiny ant hoisting enormous elephant opponent overhead. Mood: Defiant impossible triumph.

cards.power: Convert received damage into 'Sympathy' tokens.
cards.lore: Maintain the illusion of peril. Reel back. Limp to the ring. Make them believe.
cards.gradeReason: 'Make them believe' — instant performance instruction, no context needed.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Old vaudeville comic. Subject: Opossum wrestler theatrically staggering from tiny tap. Mood: Oscar-worthy suffering.

cards.power: Ignore the first 3 damage of any turn. Intimidate opponent creates 'Fear' status.
cards.lore: Sit right back up just to prove how dangerous you are. Remove all tension for ego.
cards.gradeReason: 'Sit right back up just to prove how dangerous you are' — instant body language cue.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Horror comic meets wrestling. Subject: Rhinoceros rising slowly from devastation, opponent terrified. Mood: Indestructible menace.

cards.power: Opponent looks ridiculous. Their next attack roll is halved.
cards.lore: Reacting to an attack far beyond reality. A mockery of the sport. See: Michaels vs. Hogan.
cards.gradeReason: Mechanically clear but 'oversell' needs Michaels/Hogan context to fully land.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Wild cartoon. Subject: Chicken wrestler flying backwards from a gentle tap, spinning. Mood: Maximum theatrical absurdity.

cards.power: Called Shot: Target legs to reduce enemy speed to 0. Target arms to prevent lifting.
cards.lore: Knowing a shooter required to perform their finisher. Cruel, logical, effective.
cards.gradeReason: Strategic precision is clear but the wrestling-logic framing takes a moment to click.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Clinical diagram meets action. Subject: Fox wrestler methodically targeting bear's knee. Mood: Cold calculation.

cards.power: Add +2 to Damage Perception. The move didn't hurt, but it sounds like it did.
cards.lore: Slapping the thigh when kicking. A loud sound suggests high impact. It's an audio lie.
cards.gradeReason: The audio-lie concept is brilliant but 'thigh slap' as a specific technique needs a beat.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Sound-effect comic. Subject: Kangaroo kicker mid-slap with massive SMACK! bubble. Mood: Sound design as violence.

cards.power: Stun enemy with noise. They lose their next Action.
cards.lore: Stomping on the mat when punching. Kinetic misdirection.
cards.gradeReason: 'Stun with noise' is instantly performable — noise IS the weapon here.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Impact-frame comic. Subject: Donkey punching while stomping, THUD clouds explode. Mood: Percussive misdirection.

cards.power: Absorb strikes to charge "Adrenaline."
cards.lore: The echo chamber of the torso. Loud noise, but requires many strikes to actually bruise.
cards.gradeReason: Interesting concept but 'echo chamber of the torso' is poetic description, not instant direction.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Anatomy-comic hybrid. Subject: Walrus wrestler absorbing chops, chest glowing with energy. Mood: Resilient percussion.

cards.power: Both players lose 1 HP per turn until one quits. No other moves allowed.
cards.lore: 5 minutes doing nothing but chop. A test of endurance and st[rong style pride].
cards.gradeReason: Mutual destruction ritual — pure performable standoff. CHOP CHOP CHOP says it all.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Brutal minimalist. Subject: Two bulls facing off trading chest chops, both bleeding. Mood: Savage mutual respect.

cards.power: Cannot be targeted by "Psychology" attacks while masked. If unmasked, Game Over.
cards.lore: Kayfabe sacred to their identity. The single biggest identifier. Never remove it.
cards.gradeReason: Lucha mask as identity armor — visceral stakes anyone understands immediately.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Lucha sacred art. Subject: Masked axolotl wrestler, mask glowing, opponent reaching for it. Mood: Sacred terror.

cards.power: Attempt to unmask opponent. Success = Instant disqualification (but you win the feud).
cards.lore: Attempt to maim the mask. Disrespectful, ruthless, heat-generating garbage.
cards.gradeReason: 'Heat-generating garbage' — villain brief in three words. Unmask them. Do it.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Villainous cartoon. Subject: Hyena ripping at sacred mask, crowd in horror. Mood: Crowd-boiling transgression.

cards.power: The more damage you take, the harder you hit back. Convey envy through pain.
cards.lore: Convey envy. We work harder. We are better conditioned. We will show off until we are in danger.
cards.gradeReason: 'Convey envy through pain' — pure embodiment directive. Play hurt, hit harder.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Intense manga. Subject: Badger bleeding and smiling, rising with harder strikes. Mood: Pain-fueled transcendence.

cards.power: Refuse the "Lockup." Treat the match as a Shoot Fight.
cards.lore: Rejection of traditional start. A telltale sign of a shooter. No help for inferior opponents.
cards.gradeReason: 'Limp arm' and 'shooter' are deep insider wrestling terms — this one's for the nerds only.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Stern realism. Subject: Wolf wrestler refusing handshake, arms limp, opponent confused. Mood: Cold professional disdain.

cards.power: Self-inflict 1 damage to gain immunity to "Intimidation."
cards.lore: Busting himself open to nullify threats. You can't hurt me if I hurt me first.
cards.gradeReason: 'You can't hurt me if I hurt me first' is vivid but 'juicing' as blading yourself takes a beat.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Unhinged cartoon. Subject: Bat cutting own forehead, laughing at opponent's horror. Mood: Psychotic nonchalance.

cards.power: Deploy Snake. Opponent must roll for "Terror" every turn.
cards.lore: The bag has a live snake. Terrify them before the match starts.
cards.gradeReason: Jake the Snake in four words — live snake, Terror roll. Instantly obvious.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Horror-comedy. Subject: Cobra slithering from canvas bag toward trembling opponent. Mood: Pre-match psychological warfare.

cards.power: Use 0 Energy to dodge. Attacks enrage opponent (Opponent attacks blindly).
cards.lore: Hands in pockets. It looks like a chore. The apathy makes them furious.
cards.gradeReason: 'Hands in pockets. It looks like a chore.' — physical posture directive. Embody immediately.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Slacker chic. Subject: Sloth wrestler dodging attacks with minimal movement, opponent furious. Mood: Effortless infuriating cool.

cards.power: Attack opponent's "Dignity" instead of HP.
cards.lore: Harming the opponent's dignity rather than their body. Psychological dominance.
cards.gradeReason: 'Attack Dignity instead of HP' — psychologically devastating mechanic, instant play.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Flamboyant pop art. Subject: Peacock wrestler flicking opponent's ego into dust. Mood: Gorgeous psychological domination.

cards.power: When tagged in, take 3 actions immediately.
cards.lore: Fresh partner for payback. The explosive release of tension.
cards.gradeReason: 'Explosive release of tension' — you know this moment. 3 actions = catharsis.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Action burst panel. Subject: Cheetah exploding off corner tag with crowd erupting. Mood: Pent-up fury finally unleashed.

cards.power: Accumulate 'Sympathy' tokens while taking damage. Counter-attack.
cards.lore: The Ricky Morton role. Isolated and picked apart. You are the bait.
cards.gradeReason: 'Ricky Morton role' needs context but 'You are the bait' saves it.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Pathos cartoon. Subject: Turtle wrestler taking beatings, slowly building sympathy aura. Mood: Patient suffering building to explosion.

cards.power: Triple attack on an isolated target. "The Numbers Game."
cards.lore: Knowing each other's strengths. Brawler, Flyer, Powerhouse. The collective front.
cards.gradeReason: Pack mentality + 'The Numbers Game' — pure tag team power fantasy, instant.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Gang action. Subject: Three wolves surrounding lone opponent in ring corners. Mood: Overwhelming coordinated menace.

cards.power: Reroll any one die per turn. You know the moves better than they do.
cards.lore: Knowing what to pull off. The backbone. A night off for the opponent.
cards.gradeReason: 'You know the moves better than they do' — cerebral authority, instant character.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Wise mentor comic. Subject: Owl in suit ringside whispering precise instructions. Mood: Strategic mastermind at work.

cards.power: Change Fighting Style mid-match to match Crowd Preference.
cards.lore: Play up to the crowd. If they want a heel, give them a heel. If they want a clown, honk your nose.
cards.gradeReason: 'If they want a clown, honk your nose' — perfect showman directive. Play for the room.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Showbiz cartoon. Subject: Monkey wrestler reading crowd and transforming mid-move. Mood: Pure audience manipulation.

cards.power: All 'Charisma' rolls fail. Silence amplifies the sound of impacts.
cards.lore: Taped in empty arenas. Pausing for a pop that never comes. Surreal and bizarre.
cards.gradeReason: COVID-era concept — haunting but needs the cultural moment for full resonance.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Eerie realism. Subject: Ghost wrestling alone in silent arena, silence visualized. Mood: Surreal void performance.

cards.power: Pipe in noise. Create artificial "Heat."
cards.lore: A failed attempt to hide the emptiness. Audio sweetening on a lie.
cards.gradeReason: Clever media critique — 'audio sweetening on a lie' but needs production knowledge.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Behind-the-scenes comedy. Subject: Chameleons on green screen pretending to be crowd. Mood: Desperate fake atmosphere.

cards.power: Interfere from the outside without disqualification. "I'm just a Fan!"
cards.lore: Wrestlers taking seats as audience members. Gambling on the outcome while part of the show.
cards.gradeReason: 'I'm just a Fan!' — universal con. Everyone gets the plant archetype immediately.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Conspiracy cartoon. Subject: Mole wrestler in audience disguise diving into ring. Mood: Planted chaos erupting.

cards.power: Force opponent to Sell. If they refuse, inflict Real Damage.
cards.lore: Refusing to respond. Stiff the re-seller. Degrade into a shoot fight.
cards.gradeReason: 'Inflict Real Damage' if they refuse — explosive escalation threat. Instant tension.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Tense realism. Subject: Bear wrestler grabbing opponent's collar with dead-serious eyes. Mood: Kayfabe breaking point.

cards.power: Opponent must roll Strength 6 to perform any move.
cards.lore: Refusing to cooperate. Dead weight. Extremely unprofessional.
cards.gradeReason: 'Dead weight. Extremely unprofessional.' — vivid but 'sandbag' is insider wrestling vocabulary.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Frustrated action. Subject: Hippo wrestler going completely limp while opponent strains. Mood: Passive-aggressive obstruction.

cards.power: Lose 2 Turns. The match must be improvised around you.
cards.lore: Goldberg's shoulder smashed into the ring-post. Unplanned. The crowd goes nuts because it's real.
cards.gradeReason: Goldberg reference is specific — mechanic is clear but lore needs wrestling literacy.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Painful realism. Subject: Bull wrestler clutching shoulder, match improvising around him. Mood: Unscripted danger.

cards.power: Reveal opponent's next move.
cards.lore: Short cuts for out-of-depth wrestlers. Visible spot-calling.
cards.gradeReason: 'Spot-calling' and 'cue card holder' are deep production insider terms, not immediately performative.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Behind-curtain comedy. Subject: Beaver holding cue card ringside, wrestler reading it mid-move. Mood: Transparent incompetence.

cards.power: Intimidate. Opponent starts match with -2 Willpower.
cards.lore: Terrify him before the match. Get under their skin with smoke and mirrors.
cards.gradeReason: Undertaker archetype — smoke, mirrors, -2 Willpower before it starts. Play it.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Gothic horror wrestling. Subject: Raven wrestler emerging from smoke in dark entrance. Mood: Pre-match psychological annihilation.

cards.power: Loaf around. Regain Stamina while doing nothing. 'Wake up' only at critical health.
cards.lore: Loaf around. Do as little as possible. Lash out at the crowds who ignored you.
cards.gradeReason: 'Lash out at crowds who ignored you' — immediate character direction. Do nothing until provoked.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Bored genius comic. Subject: Lion wrestler yawning while recovering, opponent bewildered. Mood: Contemptuous indifference.

cards.power: Verbal Assault. Inflict psychological damage every turn.
cards.lore: Speaks his mind. Shouting at Michael Cole. Hilarious and entertaining abuse.
cards.gradeReason: 'Verbal assault every turn' — just open your mouth. Instant, zero instruction needed.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Expressive cartoon. Subject: Parrot wrestler screaming into announcer's face mid-match. Mood: Torrential hilarious abuse.

cards.power: Instant Pin if opponent consents.
cards.lore: The Poke of Doom. A test of strength? No, a test of gullibility.
cards.gradeReason: 'A test of gullibility' — the Hogan/Nash Poke of Doom. Absurd power. Play it deadpan.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Absurdist cartoon. Subject: Gorilla flooring opponent with single finger poke, crowd stunned. Mood: Maximum absurdity minimal effort.

cards.power: +5 Damage. Can only be used once per match.
cards.lore: The Leg Drop. The most important moment. If this hits, go home.
cards.gradeReason: 'If this hits, go home.' — the finisher brief in four words. Peak drama, instant.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Explosive full-page. Subject: Wrestling leg drop hitting with nuclear force. Crowd exploding. Mood: Match-ending devastation.

cards.power: Survive a pinfall attempt. Crowd Excitement doubles.
cards.lore: Making an exciting comeback. The art of the near-fall.
cards.gradeReason: 'Kick out at 2.99' — the near-fall is the most universal wrestling moment. Instant.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Climax panel. Subject: Zebra kicking out at 2.99, crowd vertical. Mood: Explosive comeback euphoria.

cards.power: Win match in Turn 1 against any "Jobber" class card.
cards.lore: No-selling. Sit right back up. Total dominance.
cards.gradeReason: 'No-selling. Sit right back up. Total dominance.' — three-word performance brief.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Dominant action. Subject: Rhino steamrolling through opponent in seconds flat. Mood: Humiliating instant dominance.

cards.power: End the game with no winner. Both players keep their dignity.
cards.lore: Stalemate. 60 minutes. Strong style spirit means no one loses.
cards.gradeReason: 'Both players keep their dignity' is lovely — but 60-minute iron man needs wrestling context.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Exhausted beauty. Subject: Tiger and bear both standing drained, sunset bell ringing. Mood: Dignified mutual respect.

cards.power: Decide the winner before the game starts. Players must act it out.
cards.lore: The ending is pre-planned. You are just a puppet.
cards.gradeReason: 'You are just a puppet' — power fantasy of booking. Play God. Instant role.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Puppet-master drama. Subject: Spider in suit moving wrestlers like marionettes. Mood: Omnipotent backstage control.

cards.power: Improvisation. Change the plan mid-match to suit the flow.
cards.lore: Calling moves in the ring. A basic outline, filled in with sweat.
cards.gradeReason: 'Calling spots' is insider — 'change the plan mid-match' is clearer but still takes a beat.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Improv action. Subject: Cricket wrestler whispering next move mid-hold to opponent. Mood: Collaborative chaos.

cards.power: +3 Coordination. The match is perfect, but lacks "Soul."
cards.lore: Hogan vs Warrior. Heavily choreographed for weeks. It paid off.
cards.gradeReason: 'Perfect but lacks Soul' — sharp critique but Hogan/Warrior reference needs context.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Theatrical production. Subject: Two wrestlers rehearsing from choreography sheet. Mood: Perfection without spark.

cards.power: Pause the game. Both players regain Stamina. Audience gets bored (-1 Hype).
cards.lore: Slow down. Give the audience a chance to catch up. Or go get popcorn.
cards.gradeReason: 'Or go get popcorn' is great — but rest hold as intentional narrative tool needs wrestling frame.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Tired comedy. Subject: Two wrestlers locked in dull hold, audience texting. Mood: Strategic boring respite.

cards.power: All moves must be performed facing Left.
cards.lore: Playing to the crowd watching at home. If the camera didn't see it, it didn't happen.
cards.gradeReason: TV production concept — 'hard cam' is broadcasting jargon. Too inside the machine.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: TV production diagram. Subject: Wrestler adjusting to face single giant camera. Mood: Performance shaped by the lens.

cards.power: Unforgiving Steel. If you miss a charge, you take max damage.
cards.lore: Smashed into the post. The hardest object in the building.
cards.gradeReason: Physical prop is clear but 'charging the post' requires knowing the spot.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Impact physics. Subject: Fox missing charge, smashing face-first into steel post. Mood: Immediate regret.

cards.power: +2 Damage. Counts as 'Environment' not 'Weapon' (usually).
cards.lore: Brawling and hardcore techniques. Weaponized furniture.
cards.gradeReason: Steel steps as prop is clear — but the 'Environment vs Weapon' rule distinction is mechanical.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Hardcore action. Subject: Deer slamming steel steps into opponent outside ring. Mood: Legitimized furniture brutality.

cards.power: Destructible Terrain. Break to create a 'Holy Sh*t' moment.
cards.lore: Breakable furniture. Shouting at Michael Cole while destroying his desk.
cards.gradeReason: 'Shouting at Michael Cole while destroying his desk' — iconic image. BREAK THE TABLE. Now.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Destruction spectacular. Subject: Hippo driving opponent through announcer's table. Broadcaster fleeing. Mood: Holy Sh*t moment.

cards.power: Critique the match. If the match has "bad psychology" cancel the result.
cards.lore: Fans talking about "psychology" without ever taking a bump. Keyboard warriors.
cards.gradeReason: 'Keyboard warriors' critiquing bad psychology — modern archetype everyone recognizes instantly.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Ironic portrait. Subject: Toad typing furiously in crowd, surrounded by complaint speech bubbles. Mood: Smug fan impotence.

cards.power: Confusion. End turn immediately. Audience chants "You F*cked Up."
cards.lore: Incoherent collection of moves. It just looks messy.
cards.gradeReason: The chant is universal but 'botched spot' as a term still lands softer than direct invitation.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Chaotic slapstick. Subject: Octopus tangled in ropes, audience pointing and chanting. Mood: Glorious public failure.

cards.power: Arrest anyone breaking character. Enforce the Lie.
cards.lore: Protecting the business. Keep the secrets secret, or get fired.
cards.gradeReason: 'Enforce the Lie' — immediate character purpose. Arrest anyone stepping out of fiction.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Noir wrestling. Subject: Cop wrestler handcuffing character-breaker, stern authority. Mood: The fiction is law.

cards.power: Lose the game on purpose to boost opponent's XP. (Come back next week anyway).
cards.lore: Leaning on the fourth wall. Rising... and falling. See you next season.
cards.gradeReason: 'Come back next week anyway' — perfect fourth-wall meta. Everyone knows this moment.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Bittersweet epic. Subject: Phoenix wrestler lying down in defeat, crowd cheering, already rising. Mood: Glorious inevitable return.

verdict: Big Bad Brain Wrestling is the definitive Kayfabizarro flagship — 56 archetypes, moves, props and personas that make the invisible logic of professional wrestling brutally visible. The Babyface/Heel/Tweener triad alone earns a table spot. Weakness: a small cluster of ultra-insider cards (Limp Arm, Hard Cam, Cue Card Holder) rewards the wrestling-literate at the expense of first-timers. Table-ready: Yes.
blurb: For everyone who watched wrestling and screamed 'THAT'S FAKE!' — then kept watching. 56 cards of ring psychology, kayfabe philosophy, and performative chaos for groups ready to play dirty.

marketingText:
Kayfabizarro: BIG BAD BRAIN WRESTLING – Kayfabe Is the Only Honest Lie (Free Cut & Play Comic Card Game)

Wrestling is the only art that tells you it's fake, then dares you to feel it anyway.

You screamed "THAT'S FAKE" at the screen and you kept watching. Good. Now sit with the part nobody admits: the worked outrage, the slow-burn betrayal, the retirement that wasn't, the heel everyone secretly roots for. That machinery did not stay in the ring. It runs your timeline, your office politics, your favorite news cycle, every staged feud you fall for while insisting you are too smart to fall for it. Smugly calling it fake is not seeing through the con. It is the con's favorite move.

This is Social Story Wrestling turned on its own machinery: 56 cut-and-play cards of ring psychology and kayfabe philosophy. You pick up a move, you run the work out loud, and the table decides whether the crowd buys it or you get booed back through the curtain.

WHAT'S INSIDE?
- The Big Bad Brain Wrestling Core Deck: 56 High-Res "Print, Cut & Play" cards, featuring The Finger Poke (win the title in three seconds and salt the entire crowd), The Booker (the unseen hand who decides who goes over before anyone laces a boot), and The Retirement Match (the goodbye nobody believes and everybody pays for).
- The Freestyle Rules: the complete Anti-Rulebook. No spreadsheets, no math, just storytelling, dice-driven chaos, and RAF dice boxes printed on every one of the 56 cards.
- The Worked-Shoot Engine: the deck doubles as KayFaBINGO! and KayFaBOGGLE!, so the same animal-roster brawl flips into a fresh party game whenever the feud gets stale.

THE "LIVING DECK" PASS (Free Updates)
Grab this and you are not buying a frozen PDF. You are buying into the Kayfabizarro main line. Every future expansion in this cycle lands in your library as a free update, no second checkout.

WHY "PAY WHAT YOU WANT"?
I would rather a table perform the lie on purpose than pretend it is above the show. Naming the work is how you stop being worked. Broke? Enter "0" and take it. Cut it. Play it. Want to support the craft? Every dollar goes straight into the next batch of cards.

Choose your reality. Become an Epistemic Outlaw.
"Kayfabe never broke. You just stopped admitting you were already in the ring."
Stay fluffy. — Uncle FrizzleBob
